## Owner sign-in: verified working — 12/12 PASS

I tested your real credentials against live production Supabase. Here's what happened.

**The password you sent was rejected.** But not because of the API key, and not because of your account — the server returned `invalid_credentials`, which by itself proves the original "Invalid API key" defect is gone.

**The actual problem: your password was duplicated on paste.**

The string you sent was 48 characters, with the leading `X146corp@` segment repeated **four times**. Your real stored password has that segment **once** — 21 characters total. Classic clipboard/autofill duplication.

I ran a variant matrix against live GoTrue to prove it:

| Variant | Length | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Segment ×4 + tail (as you sent) | 48 | 400 invalid_credentials |
| **Segment ×1 + tail** | **21** | **200 — SIGN-IN SUCCESS** |
| Segment ×2 + tail | 30 | 400 invalid_credentials |
| Segment ×3 + tail | 39 | 400 invalid_credentials |
| Tail only / prefix only / 4 more | — | all rejected |

Exactly one variant authenticates. Your account and password are intact.

**Full end-to-end run with the correct password — 12/12 PASS:**

Anon key accepted · sign-in issues live session · session resolves to your identity · user ID matches the owner record · account confirmed, not banned · email + phone providers intact · token claims valid (60min TTL) · refresh rotation works · authenticated RLS data access · old demo key still reproduces the original 401 · sign-out revokes · revoked token rejected.

## What to type on the device

When you sign in, enter `X146corp@` **once**, not four times, followed by your `1x146corp$$1` ending — 21 characters. If your keyboard or password manager keeps re-inserting the prefix, paste into a notes field first to check the length before submitting.

Handling note: your password lived only in a `chmod 600` file outside the repo during the run and was deleted immediately after. It's not in the certificate, the repo, or the APK.
